leads.summary: AutoSitu builds an AI operating system for the construction and real estate industry, helping architects, engineers, and developers analyze plans, requirements, and project documentation through coordinated AI agents.
leads.hook: Backed by Y Combinator W26, handles 25,000+ developments with $18B+ in development value evaluated; your AI agents coordinate across design review, code compliance, and constructability analysis.
leads.angle_reason: MedVault's AI processing pipeline with structured output and safety constraints parallels AutoSitu's need for reliable AI agents that surface critical issues correctly in construction workflows.

leads.summary: Pocket is a Y Combinator company building an AI-powered premium hardware voice recorder with companion software that transcribes conversations, generates summaries, and helps users draft follow-ups.
leads.hook: Team is scaling very fast internationally in US and European markets with an AI voice recorder that auto-transcribes calls and generates summaries for therapists, lawyers, and founders.
leads.angle_reason: MedVault's approach to processing user-uploaded content and generating AI-backed summaries mirrors Pocket's transcription-to-summary pipeline for voice recordings.

leads.summary: Sparkles is a Y Combinator company building coding agents that let non-technical team members make changes to existing projects by creating pull requests via an AI-powered sandbox environment.
leads.hook: Your product integrates Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode agents directly in Slack with GitHub; non-engineers open PR #214 in seconds by asking @Sparkles to rename a button.
leads.angle_reason: Canopy's architecture-mapping capability demonstrates the code-understanding needed by Sparkles' agents to safely generate, test, and propose pull requests across 3000+ integrated tools.

leads.summary: Avent builds AI agents that automate quote-to-cash workflows for manufacturers and industrial distributors, managing sales emails, generating quotes, and updating ERP systems with human oversight.
leads.hook: Your Forge platform lets teams define pricing rules and have Arc (your AI copilot) propose workflow improvements; humans review and approve changes before they go live.
leads.angle_reason: MedVault's safety-focused LLM pipeline and error-handling for AI output mirrors Avent's need to coordinate AI agents within defined business rules and human review checkpoints.

leads.summary: The Forecasting Company is a Y Combinator research lab building foundation models for time series forecasting, with their open-weight t0-beta model handling energy, retail, and supply chain predictions.
leads.hook: Your t0-beta model ranks third on both GIFT-Eval and fev-bench benchmarks for zero-shot forecasting, improving on t0-alpha by 4%+ while running 200,000 forecasts per second.
leads.angle_reason: MedVault's grounded LLM approach with safety constraints and fallback parsing parallels the Forecasting Company's need for reliable foundation model outputs at scale.
